angles.drive: Being on your own is the setting you return to, nothing having gone wrong. Earth runs heavy in your mind, so what goes in gets turned over alone. You keep to yourself because the thinking happens there, or because showing it unfinished would leave you open. It costs you the people who stopped waiting outside.

Pulling back is where you rest, long before it is any kind of reaction. Company drains a battery in you that solitude recharges, and the door drifts toward closed on its own schedule. Nothing has to go wrong first. The pulling back is the baseline.
